acceptance_case_prefix: All cases run against fake adapter + fixture authority + disposable local store with deterministic fault injection; production authority is never written

positive_cases.name: exact authorized external mutation verified
positive_cases.given: Valid semantic authorization, valid Subject precondition (subject_expected_revision), valid raw authority precondition (raw_source_revision+observed_raw_digest), exact candidate constructed with candidate_raw_digest and normalized_plan_digest, bounded lease, valid typed target
positive_cases.when: PREPARED durably → APPLYING durably → at most one external attempt → verify read returns candidate
positive_cases.then: Terminal VERIFIED (APPLIED_VERIFIED/Y) with evidence: candidate_raw_digest, observed==candidate, journal_state=VERIFIED; idempotent replay returns REPLAYED_VERIFIED with no duplicate external effect

positive_cases.name: exact replay does not duplicate external effect
positive_cases.given: Same idempotency_key + same operation + same target + same intent_fingerprint + same complete authorization semantics + same Subject+raw preconditions as an already VERIFIED record
positive_cases.when: Duplicate executor attempts same journal identity via MutationIngressRequest with identical complete semantics
positive_cases.then: Replay returns prior VERIFIED result; no second external apply; Total duplicate effect count = 0

negative_cases.name: stale raw authority revision
negative_cases.when: External authority has advanced to revision 6 before APPLYING attempt
negative_cases.then: Read-before-write comparison fails → STALE_AUTHORITY fail closed; no external write; FAILED_NO_EFFECT; influx: stale writer cannot overwrite

negative_cases.name: changed raw digest
negative_cases.then: Precondition mismatch → STALE_AUTHORITY fail closed; no external write

negative_cases.name: authorization drift with same idempotency key
negative_cases.given: Valid prior VERIFIED with principal A; replay attempt uses principal B or different approval/Decision basis or changed mutation_scope/candidate
negative_cases.when: Same idempotency_key + same operation+target but changed complete authorization semantics (or changed intent_fingerprint)
negative_cases.then: CONFLICT with no effect; never automatic replay; Total conflict second-effect count = 0

negative_cases.name: external known failure/no effect
negative_cases.given: Valid PREPARED→APPLYING with stale successor / protected plan / invalid predecessor
negative_cases.when: Adapter definitively rejects mutation with proof of unchanged original raw state
negative_cases.then: APPLYING → FAILED_NO_EFFECT (AuthoritativeEffectConfirmation.NO); no retry via old lease

negative_cases.name: external unknown outcome
negative_cases.given: Valid APPLYING with at-most-one attempt in flight
negative_cases.when: Transport timeout / disconnect / process crash before verify
negative_cases.then: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN (AuthoritativeEffectConfirmation.UNKNOWN); blind retry denied; must reconcile before any new attempt

reconciliation_cases.name: observed candidate
reconciliation_cases.given: Stranded APPLYING / OUTCOME_UNKNOWN record with candidate_raw_digest=candidate
reconciliation_cases.when: Reconciliation read returns observed == candidate (exact raw identity)
reconciliation_cases.then: RECONCILING → VERIFIED_RECOVERED (APPLIED_VERIFIED/Y); no retry; normalized equality is irrelevant when raw matches

reconciliation_cases.name: observed original
reconciliation_cases.then: RECONCILING → RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT only after fresh semantic authorization + Subject + raw preconditions + new bounded lease/attempt are re-established; otherwise remains RECONCILING

reconciliation_cases.name: observed third state
reconciliation_cases.when: Reconciliation read returns observed == third raw state (neither original nor candidate)
reconciliation_cases.then: RECONCILING → CONFLICT; surface semantic choices; no heuristic selection, no silent rebase/overwrite/merge

reconciliation_cases.name: retry requires exact accepted authorization rule
reconciliation_cases.when: Retry via new bounded attempt with exactly the fresh authorization rule from D5 (principal, operation, typed target, mutation_scope, contract_hash, Subject+raw preconditions, exact mutation/candidate fingerprint, approval/Decision basis, expiry) and new lease
reconciliation_cases.then: New PREPARED→APPLYING→external attempt allowed; old lease reuse denied

reconciliation_cases.name: semantic ambiguity never mechanically resolved
reconciliation_cases.given: Third state conflict or multiple valid retirement successors
reconciliation_cases.when: Reconciliation encounters multiple plausible semantic outcomes
reconciliation_cases.then: Always NEEDS_SEMANTIC_CHOICE / CONFLICT boundary; recovery may not choose preferred version, merge arbitrarily, select newest/current pointer, or guess Project/Subject

concurrency_cases.name: concurrent duplicate attempt
concurrency_cases.given: Two executors attempt same journal/idempotency identity concurrently
concurrency_cases.when: Both present same complete authorization semantics and attempt to move PREPARED→APPLYING
concurrency_cases.then: Reservation/lease semantics enforce single external apply eligibility; one wins APPLYING, other sees APPLYING taken and must not issue second external write; recovery takeover reads stranded APPLYING if winner crashes before terminal persist

concurrency_cases.name: stale writer
concurrency_cases.given: Writer A read revision 5; Writer B commits revision 6 before A applies
concurrency_cases.then: Read-before-write fails closed STALE_AUTHORITY; no last-write-wins; no overwrite after stale read; if adapter supports CAS map raw_source_revision → CAS token, use native CAS; otherwise deterministic read-before-write + verify-after-write limitations apply
